svg.title: Riju confirms the launch between his expiring badge and the funding notice.
svg.desc: Riju's hand presses the final control while his temporary badge and a blank provisional-funding notice touch opposite sides of the frame. The red edge of the private anomaly file remains visible beneath his satchel.
svg.text: Page 25, panel 4 · Extreme close-up on Riju's badge, funding notice, and confirmation hand

text.tspan: Riju sees his expiring badge beside the funding
notice, hesitates, and confirms the configuration.
